mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.description, u.last_login_at, ro.name AS role FROM user u JOIN root r ON r.id = u.id JOIN role ro ON ro.id = u.role_id WHERE u.email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.description, u.last_login_at, ro.name AS role FROM social_account sa JOIN user u ON u.id = sa.user_id JOIN root r ON r.id = u.id JOIN role ro ON ro.id = u.role_id WHERE sa.provider = #{provider} AND sa.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (id, role_id, email, password, nickname, description) VALUES (#{id}, (SELECT id FROM role WHERE name = 'USER'), #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{description})
